about: Refactor 17, Stage B, decision D1: the files of the area devices join one workspace package @purin-labs/area-devices in areas/devices. scripts/refactor-17/move-module.mjs reads this plan. files: each source file that scripts/layers.json gives the module, with its place in the target folder: a Worker file goes to server/ with its sub-path below services/platform/src/, less its first folder when that folder is devices/ or commerce/ (the longer lines of sourcePrefixes give this rule, one time for each file, and no two files then share a place), a Portal file goes to ui/ and keeps its sub-path below apps/portal/src/. sourcePrefixes: where --sync-plan puts a file that the module gets later. package: the manifest and the tsconfig of the new package; the versions of devDependencies come from the Worker and the Portal manifests. The exports map gives each .ts file of server/ and of ui/ and each style sheet of ui/ as an entry; a .tsx file that another module imports has an entry of its own. The tsconfig of the package reads server/ only. The Worker tsconfigs include areas/*/server and the Portal tsconfig includes areas/*/ui (the preparation commit "Type checks: the Worker and the Portal programs read the area packages"), so each file stays in the program that checked it before the move. edits: text edits of the files that name a root folder or a source folder and cannot read scripts/lib/source-roots.mjs; an edit is done when the file holds its replace text. keepForm: each file where an import stays on its line, because the wrap of Prettier would move a ratchet, with its reason. regenerate: the commands that write a generated file again. package.typeCheck false: the package has no check:types script of its own. Its own file server/actors/device-fleet.ts reads the Env key BAKE_RUN, which services/platform/src/actors/bake-run.ts (workers/platform) merges with declare module of @purin-labs/kernel/env. Through @purin-labs/tenancy, @purin-labs/actor-runtime, @purin-labs/agent, @purin-labs/tool-handlers and @purin-labs/conversation the program also lacks ORGANISATION, SESSION, CASE, CONNECTOR, CODE_MODE_SANDBOX, MESSAGE_LINK_FETCH and EVENT_Q, and two public files of cafe that it imports by a relative path type-import Worker files. The package alone gives 159 errors, 2 of them in its own files. The first area package: the edits add the root folder areas to the source roots, the clone scan, knip and the IFC ESLint run.

edits.why: the lints that walk the product source read the new root folder areas
the clone scan reads the new root folder areas

knip reads each area package and judges each of its exports (includeEntryExports), as it judged them in the Worker and the Portal: an area package is a module of the Worker and the Portal, not an entry for others
ESLint reads the new root folder areas in pnpm lint:ifc-boundaries
the lints of the Worker source and ESLint read the Worker files of the package
the Portal lints and the ESLint rules of the Portal source read the Portal files of the package

keepForm.why: a file of the Worker module with logic (worker-logic of pnpm lint:layer-debts): Prettier wraps its two longer device imports by package name, which adds 6 lines to that count
